column1: # The second column is not decoration. A hand-written QID is exactly the kind of thing that is
# wrong without failing anything, and the harvester compares what it fetched against the name
# written here — a mismatch is logged and skipped rather than stored. The first draft of the type
# table carried a QID for "wilaya of Algeria" that was in fact Russia's administrative divisions;
# this column is how that class of mistake stops being silent.
# Every id below was resolved from its Wikipedia title against the live API, not typed from
# memory. Add rows the same way. Entities promoted from the demand queue (M8-T09) carry no
# expected name, because no human wrote one.
